description: This file defines a REST controller class 'UserRestEndpoint' with multiple endpoints to handle user operations such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting users in a web application. It uses Spring framework annotations for routing and dependency injection, and interacts with domain services and mappers.

classes.name: UserRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST controller class exposing user-related endpoints, including get, create, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a user by userId, with validation for placeholder values.

methods.name: createNewUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new user based on provided UserResource.

methods.name: updateExistingUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing user based on provided UserResource.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a user by userId, with validation and error handling for non-numeric IDs.

methods.name: safe
methods.description: A helper method to escape backslashes and quotes in strings.

methods.name: isPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks if a given string value matches placeholder patterns such as {userId}.
